checks.title: Input, hash, version, and coverage integrity
Distinct time roles, timezone, and tzdb evidence

evidence.causal_topology: published_time <= vendor_available_time <= ingested_time <= parse_ready_time; OBSERVED_BY_PREDICTION also requires event_time <= published_time

checks.title: Versioned exchange calendar and session alignment
Stable security identity and valid-time mapping

evidence.rule: RAW only; PIT_ADJUSTED and FULL_HISTORY_ADJUSTED are unsupported and fail closed in v1

evidence.predicate: after halt_time, tradable_time requires trade_resume_time; quote_resume_time is not a proxy

checks.title: Required values, types, and finite numerics

evidence.policy: Only sourced semantic bounds can hard-fail; no universal z-score or outlier cutoff is imposed.

checks.title: Label definition, interval order, and contract hash
Cross-split label overlap and purge evidence
notes: Same-split overlap is reported as dependence, not treated as leakage by itself.

limitations: The audit validates bound evidence; it cannot prove a vendor description is truthful.
Hashes and receipts cannot prove that no off-system future data was consulted.
Qualification applies only to the exact claim, consumed-value view, and hashes shown.
scope_note: Data eligibility only: no model training, alpha calculation, deployment approval, or capital decision is performed.
